title: In silico study reveals unconventional interactions between MDC1 of DDR and Beclin-1 of autophagy.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟预测MDC1 FHA结构域与Beclin-1 CCD的蛋白-蛋白互作，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白互作建模方法，可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: DNA damage response (DDR) and autophagy are concerned with maintaining cellular homeostasis and dysregulation of these two pathways lead to pathologic conditions including tumorigenesis. Autophagy is activated as a protective mechanism during DDR which is indicative of their functional cooperativity but the molecular mechanism leading to the convergence of these two pathways during genotoxic stress remains elusive. In this study, through in silico analysis, we have shown an interaction between the Mediator of DNA damage checkpoint 1 (MDC1), an important DDR-associated protein, and Beclin-1, an autophagy inducer. MDC1 is an adaptor or scaffold protein known to regulate DDR, apoptosis, and cell cycle progression. While, Beclin-1 is involved in autophagosome nucleation and exhibits affinity for binding to Fork-head-associated domain (FHA) containing proteins. The FHA domain is commonly conserved in DDR-related proteins including MDC1. Through molecular docking, we have predicted the modeled complex between the MDC1 FHA domain and the Beclin-1 Coiled coil domain (CCD). The docking complex was modeled using ClusPro2.0, based on the crystal structure for the dimerized MDC1 FHA domain and Beclin-1 CCD. The complex stability and binding affinities were assessed using a Ramachandran plot, MD simulation, MM/GBSA, and PRODIGY webserver. Finally, the hot-spot residues at the interface were determined using computational alanine scanning by the DrugScore(PPI) webserver. Our analysis unveils significant interaction between MDC1 and Beclin-1, involving hydrogen bonds, non-bonded contacts, and salt bridges and indicates MDC1 possibly recruits Beclin-1 to the DSBs, as a consequence of which Beclin-1 is able to modulate DDR.
abstract_zh: DNA损伤应答（DDR）与自噬涉及维持细胞稳态，这两条通路的失调会导致包括肿瘤发生在内的病理状态。在DDR过程中，自噬被激活作为一种保护机制，这表明它们具有功能协同性，但导致这两种通路在基因毒性应激下汇聚的分子机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，通过计算机模拟分析，我们展示了DNA损伤检查点介质1（MDC1）（一种重要的DDR相关蛋白）与Beclin-1（一种自噬诱导因子）之间的相互作用。MDC1是一种已知调节DDR、凋亡和细胞周期进程的衔接蛋白或支架蛋白。而Beclin-1参与自噬体成核，并对含有叉头相关结构域（FHA）的蛋白质表现出结合亲和力。FHA结构域在包括MDC1在内的DDR相关蛋白中普遍保守。通过分子对接，我们预测了MDC1 FHA结构域与Beclin-1卷曲螺旋结构域（CCD）之间的建模复合物。该对接复合物基于二聚化MDC1 FHA结构域和Beclin-1 CCD的晶体结构，使用ClusPro2.0进行建模。复合物的稳定性和结合亲和力通过Ramachandran图、MD模拟、MM/GBSA和PRODIGY网络服务器进行评估。最后，使用DrugScore(PPI)网络服务器通过计算丙氨酸扫描确定了界面上的热点残基。我们的分析揭示了MDC1与Beclin-1之间的显著相互作用，涉及氢键、非键接触和盐桥，并表明MDC1可能将Beclin-1招募至DNA双链断裂（DSBs）处，从而使得Beclin-1能够调节DDR。
